notes: Each workflow built its own package from its actual checkout. The PR used a GitHub synthetic merge, whose parents are recorded explicitly.
The Push CI emitted the same ZIP byte count and SHA256 as the fixed local 7074 package. The PR merge build has a separate ZIP identity. Platform upload/readback is outside this CI record.
Static NOT_READY with errors=0 and gaps=668 is preserved as observed for this source. It does not attest fresh delivery evidence, visual approval, user acceptance, or a physical phone test.
Raw job logs and API response bodies are not embedded. SHA256 values cover their exact gh api stdout bytes. Signed artifact redirect URLs and credentials are never stored.
